newsitem.title: USA: United States Filter buys land, water rights.
newsitem.headline: United States Filter buys land, water rights.

text.p: United States Filter Corp said early on Monday that it has acquired about 50,000 acres of land and water rights in the southwest part of the U.S. in exchange for U.S. Filter common stock and warrants.
It said it acquired the land and water rights from several entities, including Western Farms LP, owned by members of the Bass family of Fort Worth, Texas.
The land includes about 45,000 acres in the Imperial Valley in California and more than 5,000 acres in other parts of the southwestern United States.

Along with the land, U.S. Filter (USF) acquired the associated water rights to about 250,000 acre feet per year of water usage, most of which are Colorado River water rights, through the Imperial Irrigation District (IID) of California.
In exchange, the Bass entities will receive eight million common shares of U.S. Filter and warrants to acquire another 1.2 million shares of U.S. Filter stock, the company said.
As to the warrants, 600,000 will be exercisable at $500 per USF share and 600,000 will be exercisable at $60 per share of USF stock, it said.
The company said that the Bass entities have agreed not to exercise their demand registration rights on the acquired U.S. Filter stock until the year 2000.
In addition, the Bass entities will receive a seat on the company's board of directors.
Rental income from agricultural use of the acquired property is sufficient to make the transaction non-dilutive, the company said.

"We think U.S. Filter is uniquely qualified to take advantage of the tremendous assets being acquired in this transaction," Chairman, President and Chief Executive Richard Heckmann said in a statement.

"We now add the most important product -- the water -- to our one-stop shop business strategy. Importantly, we are also adding a major new customer segment -- agriculture -- one which we believe we can serve in many ways."
U.S. Filter is a global provider of water and wastewater treatment equipment, systems and services.
